versions.changelog:
- 新增第一周 PPTX 模板文件：template/第一周作业—明确人生的目的和意义.pptx
- 移除 skill-card.md 文件
- 其他内容未变，功能保持不变

Initial release of 49-days-learner as an AI assistant for the "49天成功方程式训练营" coursework.

- Supports guided completion of pre-camp orientation and week 1–5 assignments plus final exam, based on editable PPTX templates.
- Stepwise collection and confirmation of student identity and self-introduction, with fact-based, template-aligned content generation.
- One-by-one progression through each assignment section, with clear prompts, answers reflected back for confirmation, and actionable feedback.
- Completion and quality scoring at each step, plus clear tracking of missing items and progress status.
- Final outputs are original PPTX files, properly named and formatted according to student and course details.
